name: Aspis Soul
raw_text: Available with all weapons Type Passive Neutral Description The shield of faith. Gains a permanent effect that reduces Fractional Damage aimed at you. Also gains an effect that prevents status ailments at a certain time. All Weapons When in a party, Fractional Damage resistance is increased further according to the number of members ( up to 3 ) who are still alive. The effect that prevents status ailments is gained at the beginning of a boss battle and when naturally recovering from a status ailment. Staff Thrust
